verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing has a documented public REST API. Its reference covers creating cards and cardholders, real-time authorization webhooks, spending controls, funding and disputes, with a test mode for simulating purchases. Community comments independently describe it as an 'API-first product' consistent with 'the rest of the Stripe API'. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe found 404 at the standard paths); historical invitation-only access noted by the community.
